title: AMUSE: Anytime Muon with Stable Gradient Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2605.22432v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Modern deep learning commonly relies on AdamW with prescribed learning rate schedules, but recent works challenge both components: Schedule-Free optimization removes explicit schedules via iterate averaging, and Muon improves the update geometry by orthogonalizing momentum for matrix parameters. Despite Muon's strong empirical performance, its underlying mechanism remains partially understood. We study Muon through the river-valley loss landscape, where useful training progress occurs along a flat, low-curvature bulk subspace (the river), while high-curvature dominant directions form steep valley walls that induce oscillations. We empirically show that while Muon's orthogonalization accelerates river progress by increasing the bulk component, it also amplifies dominant-direction noise, causing oscillatory trajectories. translated_title: AMUSE：具有稳定梯度评估的随时Muon优化器
translated_abstract: 现代深度学习通常依赖于AdamW和预设的学习率调度，但近期的研究对这两个组件都提出了挑战：Schedule-Free优化通过迭代平均去除了显式调度，而Muon通过对矩阵参数的动量进行正交化来改进更新的几何结构。尽管Muon具有出色的实证性能，但其底层机制仍未被完全理解。我们通过“河谷”损失景观来研究Muon：在该景观中，有效的训练进展沿着平坦、低曲率的主体子空间（河流）进行，而高曲率的支配方向则形成陡峭的谷壁并引发振荡。我们通过实证表明，虽然Muon的正交化通过增加主体分量来加速河流进展，但它同时也放大了支配方向的噪声，导致轨迹出现振荡。基于这一发现，我们提出了具有稳定梯度评估的随时Muon优化器（AMUSE），该方法集成了Muon的快速主体……
tldr: 该论文提出AMUSE优化器，通过“河谷”损失景观理论揭示了Muon正交化虽加速主体方向进展但会放大支配方向噪声引发振荡的问题，并结合稳定梯度评估与随时调度能力来加以改进。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes AMUSE, an optimizer that leverages the river-valley loss landscape to reveal how Muon's orthogonalization accelerates progress along the flat bulk subspace while amplifying dominant-direction noise causing oscillations, and addresses this by integrating stable gradient evaluation with anytime scheduling.
